title: Chinese AI firms shunned US delegation over sanctions fears, commission says
summary: A US congressional advisory body on China said on Friday that leading Chinese artificial intelligence firms declined to meet its members during a recent Beijing visit over concerns that doing so could expose the firms to US sanctions.
